authorization.scope: Admit all reviewed usable questions and prepare a pull request; no Special Pass/Collect or new per-item human review.

restoration_scope: The archived delivery contains formal rows/assets and historical hashes but not the original source_notes objects. Current source notes are reconstructed from archived source records, item histories and review evidence. Historical note/content hashes are retained as history, not claimed as reproduced. Current content fingerprints bind the newly documented notes under renewed authorization.
preserved_content: Formal dataset rows, source images, current images, scenes, scripts and frozen runtime dependencies are copied unchanged from the reviewed archive. Existing 1018 questions and Special data remain unchanged.
